NTPC Intern Portal — Flowchart & Screenshot Walkthrough

Complete 12-Step Visual Journey & Approval System Flowchart

1
Step 1: User Registration & Role Selection
http://localhost:5174/signup
Flow Explanation: New users begin by registering an account on the NTPC Intern Portal. Users specify their Full Name, Email Address, Password, and select their assigned Portal Role (Proposer, Guide, Guide GM, Training Officer, or HR GM).
⬇
2
Step 2: Email Verification OTP Email
mailto:user@ntpc.co.in
Flow Explanation: Upon registration, the system dispatches an automated 6-digit One-Time Password (OTP) valid for 10 minutes to verify email authenticity before activating the account.
⬇
3
Step 3: User Authentication & Captcha Verification
http://localhost:5174/login
Flow Explanation: Registered users sign in with their verified credentials and a 6-character captcha security verification code. Successful authentication issues a role-scoped JWT token.
⬇
4
Step 4: Proposer Submission — Trainee & Institute Details
http://localhost:5174/TraineeDetails
Flow Explanation: The Proposer fills out Part 1 of the request form, providing Trainee Name, Relationship, University/Institute name, School/Department, Address, Training Start/End Dates, and Area of Training.
⬇
5
Step 5: Proposer Submission — Guide & Department Assignment
http://localhost:5174/GuideDetails
Flow Explanation: The Proposer selects the designated Guide/Mentor Name, Designation (e.g. Senior Manager, DGM), and NTPC Department (e.g. IT, HR, Finance) to route the approval request.
⬇
6
Step 6: Proposer Portal — Applications Dashboard
http://localhost:5174/ProposerDashboard
Flow Explanation: The Proposer views all submitted intern requests in a clean tabular dashboard displaying Trainee Name, Institute, Assigned Guide, Submission Date, and current Status Badge.
⬇
7
Step 7: Proposer Portal — Real-Time 5-Tier Stepper Tracker
http://localhost:5174/ProposerDashboard
Flow Explanation: Expanding any application reveals the live 5-stage progress bar (Proposer ➔ Guide ➔ Dept GM ➔ Training Officer ➔ HR GM), allowing real-time tracking of sign-offs.
⬇
8
Step 8: Tier 1 Approval — Assigned Guide (Mentor) Review
http://localhost:5174/dashboard
Flow Explanation: The assigned Guide logs into the Reviewer Dashboard, verifies the trainee proposal, adds optional review remarks, and clicks "Approve & Forward" to advance the request to Tier 2.
⬇
9
Step 9: Tier 2 Approval — Department Head (Dept GM) Sign-Off
http://localhost:5174/dashboard
Flow Explanation: The Guide General Manager reviews requests scoped exclusively to their department. Upon approval, the request advances to Tier 3 (Training Officer). Rejection rolls back to Guide.
⬇
10
Step 10: Tier 3 Approval — Training Officer Verification
http://localhost:5174/dashboard
Flow Explanation: The Training Officer verifies institute credentials, training slots, and corporate guidelines before approving the request for final HR General Manager sign-off.
⬇
11
Step 11: Tier 4 Approval — HR GM Final Sign-Off & Digital Signature
http://localhost:5174/dashboard
Flow Explanation: The HR General Manager performs final authorization, uploads an official HR digital signature image, and clicks "Approve & Issue Training Letter" to trigger document fulfillment.
⬇
12
Step 12: Automated Email Delivery & Official PDF Letter Generation
mailto:proposer@ntpc.co.in
Flow Explanation: PDFKit dynamically generates the official NTPC Training Permission Letter with corporate blue logo, reference number, terms, and embedded HR signature, immediately emailing it to the Proposer and Trainee.
